statements.t: The transaction is expected to close in November 2026 and further advances the Company's portfolio optimization strategy.

The Company has strengthened operational leadership and is executing targeted operational initiatives to improve throughput, increase machine and labor productivity, and enhance overall cost efficiency.

The Company intends to deploy the remaining proceeds in support of capital allocation priorities, which may include organic growth investments, strategic acquisitions and additional share repurchases.
The Company has reaffirmed its adjusted diluted earnings per share (2) (EPS) outlook for full-year 2026 of $1.60 to $1.70.
The Company now expects 4% to 6% year-over-year sales growth across its combined Packaging and Specialty Products businesses, a modest increase from its prior outlook of 3% to 6%.

The Company also expects approximately 250 basis points of adjusted operating profit margin expansion year-over-year, reflecting the benefits of cost-reduction actions and organizational realignment initiatives, partially offset by the extended throughput challenges within Specialty Products.

Reconciliations of forward-looking non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are provided only for the expected impact of amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets for completed acquisitions, as the Company is unable to provide estimates of future Special Items (1) or amortization from future acquisitions without unreasonable effort, due to the uncertainty and…
